name: Child Tax Credit - Married Filing Jointly, Texas, 2 children (no phaseout)
description: MFJ couple earning $150,000 in Texas (no state tax, no SDI) with 2 dependent children - well under the $400,000 MFJ CTC phaseout threshold

sources.description: IRS 2026 brackets/standard deduction (Rev. Proc. 2025-32) plus IRS Child Tax Credit page
sources.notes: Standard deduction (MFJ 2026) = $32,200. Taxable income = 150,000-32,200=117,800. Federal tax: 10%*24,800=2,480; 12%*76,000=9,120; 22%*17,000=3,740. Total=15,340. State tax (Texas)=0. SS=150,000*6.2%=9,300. Medicare=150,000*1.45%=2,175. Additional Medicare: MFJ threshold $250,000>150,000 => 0. total_fica=11,475. total_deductions (pre-credit)=15,340+0+11,475=26,815. CTC: MAGI proxy=150,000<$400,000 MFJ threshold => no phaseout. ctc_raw=2*$2,200=$4,400, capped at federal_income_tax (15,340) => not binding, child_tax_credit=4,400. net_tax_burden=26,815-4,400=22,415. net=150,000-22,415=127,585. effective_rate=22,415/150,000=0.14943.

sources.description: IRS - Official Child Tax Credit page: $2,200/qualifying child, full credit up to $400,000 (MFJ)
